references.text: Moses predicts that the Lord will hand over the enemies and strike them completely, without survivors—the same theme as in Joshua's conquest of Ai
The immediate context describing a two-sided ambush where Israel's army trapped the inhabitants of Ai in the middle
Similar language about complete destruction with no survivors in Joshua's campaign against the Canaanite kings
The same pattern of total victory where no survivors were spared, as part of Joshua's northern campaign
A parallel account from Moses' time where they struck the enemy completely without leaving any survivors
An earlier example of Israel's complete victory over King Og where no survivors were left
Saul received similar orders not to spare any of the Amalekites—the same concept of total destruction
